name: Sunforge Greatblade
powerText: Calls down a burning sun on everything in front of you.
origin: Sunforge Greatblade was forged from the furnace that once warmed every home in the Foundry. Varkath carried it before he accepted the Still King's binding.

name: Ashen Reaper
powerText: A wide reap that leaves a ring of embers burning.
origin: Ashen Reaper belonged to the keeper of the Foundry's outer orchards. Its ember-ring cleared diseased branches without burning the roots.

name: Emberheart Cleaver
powerText: Splits the ground and floods the crack with magma.
origin: Emberheart Cleaver opened channels for molten ore beneath the Foundry. Its makers gave it a name that honored the guardian's living ember.

name: Blazewing Katana
powerText: A quick-draw slash that trails burning feathers.
origin: Blazewing Katana was carried by a courier of the dawn watch. Its phoenix draw signaled that another village had survived the night.

name: Flare Ring
powerText: Circles you once, setting everything it touches alight.
origin: Flare Ring guarded the circle of smiths who tended the Foundry's communal kiln. Its orbit kept hungry flames inside their stone boundary.

name: Kindled Blade
powerText: Wraps the blade in fire for three strikes.
origin: Kindled Blade was an apprentice's first successful forging. A tiny ember sealed inside its spine refused to go out when the furnaces were ordered cold.

name: Torchbearer Pike
powerText: A lunge that bursts into flame on impact.
origin: Torchbearer Pike marked safe routes across the Foundry's night bridges. Its bearer walked last so no traveler was left in darkness.

name: Hearthwood Staff
powerText: Hurls a ball of flame that bursts on contact.
origin: Hearthwood Staff grew from the tree beside the village bakery. A healer fitted its living grain with a coal that gave heat without taking root in flame.

name: Ember Knife
powerText: A quick stab with a chance to burn.
origin: Ember Knife was a kitchen blade before its owner carried it beyond the village walls. Its hidden ember could light one meal even in driving rain.

name: Cinder Pair
powerText: Four fast cuts that leave small burns.
origin: Cinder Pair were forged for siblings who kept opposite gates of the furnace hall. Each dagger glowed brighter when the other bearer drew near.

name: Smith's Mallet
powerText: A heavy blow that throws a shower of sparks.
origin: Before it shaped weapons, Smith's Mallet repaired the village bells. When Varkath ordered every forge extinguished, its smith kept one ember alive beneath the anvil.

name: Charred Longbow
powerText: An arrow that catches fire in flight.
origin: Charred Longbow belonged to a watchkeeper stationed above the furnace roofs. It survived the night its tower burned because its bearer refused to abandon the lookout.

name: Abyssal Tide Trident
powerText: Raises a towering wave shaped like a sea serpent and brings it down.
origin: Nerith carried Abyssal Tide Trident when she still guided ships safely home. Its three points once commanded current, tide and rain.

name: Moonwell Staff
powerText: Traps a foe inside a sphere of spinning water.
origin: Moonwell Staff was carved for an apprentice who read the moon's reflection instead of the stars. Nerith trusted her to guide travelers on cloudy nights.

name: Riptide Katana
powerText: A slash that drags foes in on a current.
origin: Riptide Katana belonged to the keeper of a harbor's closing gate. Its curve followed the current that carried the last arriving boats safely inside.

name: Whirlpool Disc
powerText: Spins into a whirlpool that pulls everything to its center.
origin: Whirlpool Disc turned above the pumps of a town built below sea level. Its maker borrowed the shape of a circling tide to keep the streets dry.

name: Rainfall Bow
powerText: One arrow splits into a rain of water bolts.
origin: Rainfall Bow was strung by a gardener who could hear clouds approaching. Its arrows once brought rain to terraces too high for the river.

name: Brookblade
powerText: Sends a ripple of water rolling forward.
origin: Brookblade was a ferryman's answer to a river that kept changing course. Its narrow edge found calm water inside a dangerous current.

name: Pearl Fang
powerText: A thrust that hits like a breaking wave.
origin: Pearl Fang came from a shell recovered by a diver who repaired harbor foundations. She used its gentle gleam to find cracks below the waterline.

name: Mistcutter
powerText: A reap that leaves a blinding mist behind.
origin: Mistcutter cleared the fog between two river settlements. Its bearer drew slow arcs so travelers could see each other before they crossed.

name: Harborguard Blade
powerText: A heavy swing that lands with a splash.
origin: Harborguard Blade was carried by a night watchman who never sailed. He knew every returning ship by the sound of its mooring bell.

name: Driftwood Axe
powerText: A chop that soaks the target.
origin: Driftwood Axe was made after a storm left an entire boat beside a carpenter's door. He fashioned its handle from the wreck to rebuild the fishing pier.

name: Anchor Maul
powerText: A slam that knocks foes off balance.
origin: Anchor Maul belonged to the harbor's chain keeper. Its heavy head set anchors that held boats steady without breaking their hulls.

name: Raindrop Twins
powerText: Quick cuts that slow the target.
origin: Raindrop Twins were carried by two scouts mapping islands that appeared only at low tide. Their tips rang softly whenever a safe crossing emerged.

name: Galewhisper Bow
powerText: Fires one arrow that grows into a roaring tornado.
origin: Galewhisper Bow was shaped for a sentinel who listened to the air between the floating skyways. Its arrow could carry a warning farther than any voice.

name: Zephyr Fangs
powerText: Dashes through foes in a blur of cutting wind.
origin: Zephyr Fangs belonged to a climber who fixed ropes beneath the cloud bridges. One dagger held fast while the other opened the next handhold.

name: Skyreaver Ring
powerText: A spinning ring that swells into a cyclone.
origin: Skyreaver Ring circled the bells of a high-altitude observatory. Its arc swept dangerous ice from their supports before each new watch.

name: Featherstorm Lance
powerText: A thrust that launches foes into the air.
origin: Featherstorm Lance marked the route of a migrating flock. A skyway guide carried it so travelers could follow the birds between distant platforms.

name: Windrunner Sabre
powerText: Rides a gust to strike from behind.
origin: Windrunner Sabre was a messenger's companion on bridges with no railings. Its balanced edge cut loose ropes without disturbing the air beneath his feet.

name: Breeze Katana
powerText: A quick-draw that sends out a crescent of air.
origin: Breeze Katana was forged beside an open window so its steel would remember a gentle wind. Its bearer practiced drawing it without disturbing a candle.

name: Kite Staff
powerText: A blast of wind that pushes foes away.
origin: Kite Staff helped a village measure the wind before children flew their first kites. Its ribbons changed direction before the weather did.

name: Swift Quill
powerText: Throws the blade on a gust, and it flies back.
origin: Swift Quill served a cartographer who carved route notes into bridge posts. Its fine point could write clearly even when the platform swayed.

name: Hillside Hatchet
powerText: A spinning chop that kicks up dust.
origin: Hillside Hatchet was used to clear fallen branches from a narrow mountain road. Its owner measured a day's work by how many travelers passed safely.

name: Windmill Mallet
powerText: Spins once, then slams down.
origin: Windmill Mallet repaired the wooden sails of the skyway settlements. Its worn handle belonged to generations of mill keepers.

name: Plainswind Blade
powerText: A wide swing that flattens the grass.
origin: Plainswind Blade guarded the open fields below the floating roads. Its broad steel reflected the sky so distant walkers could recognize a safe camp.

name: Reed Sickle
powerText: A light reap carried by the wind.
origin: Reed Sickle was a basket maker's tool beside a windy marsh. Each cut reed became part of a pack carried onto the long road.

name: Mountainheart Maul
powerText: Slams the ground and raises a ring of stone spires.
origin: Mountainheart Maul rested in Gorren's hands when he raised the first safe paths through the stone. Its power could lift a road as easily as shatter a wall.

name: Ironroot Waraxe
powerText: A cleave that sends a shockwave through the ground.
origin: Ironroot Waraxe cut only the roots threatening the Citadel's foundations. Its bearer promised never to fell a living tree without planting another.

name: Monolith Edge
powerText: Encases the blade in rock for one crushing strike.
origin: Monolith Edge was lifted from a stone boundary older than the Citadel. Its maker kept the original marker's inscription beneath the new hilt.

name: Geode Staff
powerText: Grows sharp crystals from the ground around a foe.
origin: Geode Staff was carried by a surveyor who listened for hollow stone. Its crystal warned her when a tunnel needed supports rather than another strike.

name: Thornvine Scythe
powerText: Thorny vines burst up wherever the blade passes.
origin: Thornvine Scythe belonged to the Citadel's garden keeper. Its living hook untangled vines without tearing the plants they sheltered.

name: Quarry Pike
powerText: A thrust that raises a spike of stone.
origin: Quarry Pike measured safe footholds on the quarry walls. Its bearer carved small ledges for workers carrying loads down the steep road.

name: Flint Twins
powerText: Fast cuts that throw off stone chips.
origin: Flint Twins were made by a pair of tunnel scouts. Together they could strike a spark in damp air when ordinary tinder failed.

name: Oakheart Bow
powerText: Fires an arrow as heavy as a stone.
origin: Oakheart Bow grew around a branch spared when the Citadel was built. Its guardian refused to cut the final tree shading the workers' camp.

name: Stonecutter Sword
powerText: A solid strike that cracks stone.
origin: Stonecutter Sword was once a mason's straightedge fitted with a sharpened spine. Its marks measured walls built to keep out rain, not strangers.

name: Granite Shiv
powerText: A stab that kicks grit in the eyes.
origin: Granite Shiv was carved by a traveler stranded outside the Citadel. It served as both a cutting tool and a small reminder of the mountain she hoped to cross.

name: Sandstone Katana
powerText: A quick draw that raises a cloud of dust.
origin: Sandstone Katana was forged for a sentry at the desert edge. Its pale sheath stayed cool enough to carry through the midday heat.

name: Millstone Ring
powerText: Rolls along the ground and flattens what it hits.
origin: Millstone Ring was carved from the village's first flour mill. Its turning edge recalled the wheel that fed the workers building the Citadel.

name: Stormfang Twins
powerText: Splits into lightning and strikes every foe at once.
origin: Stormfang Twins were borne by the Stormspire's two signal keepers. Their answering arcs told distant settlements that a storm was safe to cross.

name: Skypiercer Spear
powerText: Hurled into the sky, it calls down a pillar of lightning.
origin: Skypiercer Spear was planted on the Stormspire to guide lightning away from the houses below. Its bearer stood beside it through every storm.

name: Voltedge Blade
powerText: A slash whose spark jumps from foe to foe.
origin: Voltedge Blade belonged to an engineer who connected the outlying settlements to the Stormspire. Its charge could wake a stalled relay without destroying it.

name: Thunderclap Katana
powerText: Crosses the field in one lightning-fast strike.
origin: Thunderclap Katana was drawn only when the Stormspire's alarm bells failed. Its sharp report carried a warning across the rain.

name: Stormcaller Maul
powerText: A leap and slam that cracks the air.
origin: Stormcaller Maul drove grounding rods into the cliff below Orvek's tower. Its bearer let the earth take the lightning that would have reached the village.

name: Arc Bow
powerText: An arrow that chains to a second target.
origin: Arc Bow belonged to a scout who sent signals between stormbound camps. Its arrows traced a brief glowing path without setting the tents alight.

name: Static Axe
powerText: A chop that stuns for a moment.
origin: Static Axe was a line keeper's tool on the roads below the Stormspire. Its controlled charge loosened damaged joints without burning their wooden supports.

name: Bolt Ring
powerText: Bounces between foes three times.
origin: Bolt Ring circled a workshop's small generators. Its maker designed it to carry power between broken contacts until proper repairs could be made.

name: Copper Rod
powerText: A small bolt from the tip.
origin: Copper Rod was carried by an apprentice testing the Stormspire's ground wires. Its modest tip found faults that brighter instruments missed.

name: Squall Blade
powerText: A heavy swing that crackles on impact.
origin: Squall Blade guarded a cliffside shelter where storms drove travelers together. Its broad steel caught the first flash so the keeper knew when to close the shutters.

name: Static Sickle
powerText: A reap that leaves sparks behind.
origin: Static Sickle trimmed the reeds around a storm-road relay. Its faint charge kept wet stems from bridging the exposed contacts.

name: Spark Shiv
powerText: A jab with a sting of static.
origin: Spark Shiv was made from the first successful coil of a village tinkerer. It held just enough charge to light a tiny emergency beacon.

name: Stepstorm Sovereigns
powerText: Turns each stride into a focused surge of golden lightning.
origin: Forged for a messenger who crossed the storm before thunder could follow, Stepstorm Sovereigns carried the last warning between the five realms.

name: Emberroad Twins
powerText: Twin ember arcs clear a safe passage through the ash.
origin: Cindrel forged Emberroad Twins for the couriers who crossed the Foundry's basalt bridge after sunset. Their curved iron edges carry the heat of the first road lantern.

name: Kilnkeeper's Pick
powerText: A focused pick strike splits the binding and rekindles the kiln.
origin: Kilnkeeper's Pick was made for Brannok beneath the Foundry's bell towers. Its square hammer face closes the kiln safely; its long point opens the channels that carry warmth to the workers.

name: Cinderloom Lantern
powerText: Ember threads carry a measured resonance through the sealed memories.
origin: Ilyra fashioned Cinderloom Lantern from a twisted staff and a crescent of bronze. The suspended ember once lit the names woven into the refuge walls, one memory for every traveler.

name: Furnacegate Halberd
powerText: A split-flame sweep breaks the gate's binding without extinguishing its fire.
origin: Furnacegate Halberd was Rhazek's command standard at the Foundry's forge gate. Its branching black-iron head split burning debris while the marshal guided apprentices down the basalt steps.

name: Estuary Hookblade
powerText: A hooked tide arc parts the binding and keeps the estuary road open.
origin: Mirel's hooked saber was tempered where the Foundry's river first met the sea. Its blue-glass edge follows the same curve she once traced through flooded gates to guide stranded travelers home.

name: Breakwater Maul
powerText: A measured hammer pulse turns a crushing tide into a sheltering current.
origin: Thalos forged this square tide hammer to drive the Archive's floodgate pins. Bronze scrolls curl over blue steel like the currents he measured each morning; every worn striking face records a wall held against the sea.

name: Memorytide Focus
powerText: A pearl-held resonance untangles lost memories without washing them away.
origin: Seryn gathered a single pearl from the Archive's first tide pool and held it within a crescent of condensed water. The Memorytide Focus stores a voice without sealing it away, letting every remembered name return to its owner.

name: Abysswatch Trident
powerText: Three precise currents break the final ward and guide travelers through the deep.
origin: Orrun's trident was shaped for the deepest Archive passage. Its three sea-glass prongs mark the vows of the abyssal watch: remember the traveler, keep the road, and never mistake a warning for a sentence.
